items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Development tools / Testing

*   Code Coverage
    *   [minikin/cargo-crap (⭐408)](https://github.com/minikin/cargo-crap) \[[cargo-crap](https://crates.io/crates/cargo-crap)] - Finds complex, untested functions by combining cyclomatic complexity with LCOV coverage (the CRAP metric) and gates CI on the score
    *   [supercorp-ai/supercov (⭐59)](https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov) \[[supercov](https://crates.io/crates/supercov)] - Code quality and test coverage for coding agents: Jev scores each source file so the agent knows what to fix first [![CI](https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/supercorp-ai/supercov/actions)
    *   [tarpaulin](https://crates.io/crates/cargo-tarpaulin) - A code coverage tool

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### Code Quality

*   [tomosu.ai](https://tomosu.ai/) - Scores a repository or pull request with a 0-100 Production Reliability Index, plus fix suggestions and a merge verdict. Free for one repository (public or private) through the VS Code/Cursor plugin, web scan, and GitHub App PR comments.

items.title: Awesome Datascience
items.content_text:
### Tools

*   [YYLO Benchmark (⭐1)](https://github.com/yylo-dev/yylo-benchmark) - Open-source trusted-host experiment runner for historical agent tasks, supplied coding prompts, and workflows. Runs independent attempts with retained outputs, and compares models, harnesses, and configurations with different checks or judges later. MIT licensed.
